about: Filters the huggingface.co listing pages offer that the Hub's tags-by-type API does not list (or lists under a different parameter). Read off the live sidebar of https://huggingface.co/models and https://huggingface.co/datasets in a logged-in browser on 2026-11-14. build.py checks every one live and records its result count. Add a value here when the Hub sidebar grows one.

apps.note: Sidebar links read other=<app>, but clicking one rewrites the URL to apps=<app>. Use apps=: on 2026-11-14 other=lmstudio matched 154 models (the literal tag) while apps=lmstudio matched 238,915 (every model LM Studio can run).

other.note: The sidebar's Other tab. Model type: base, adapter, finetune, quantized, merge. Region and deploy targets also go through other=.

inference_provider.note: Union of the sidebar's provider links and INFERENCE_PROVIDERS in huggingface.js (packages/inference/src/types.ts). inference_provider=all is the 'Inference Available' toggle.

other.note: rl-environment sits on the sidebar's Main tab; the rest are the Other tab and come from the tags API.
